meta.name: Migrate Salesforce opportunity line items to GoHighLevel with Google Sheets

name: Bulk Migrate Salesforce Opportunity Line Items to GoHighLevel Custom Object Records

parameters.content:
## 📦 Opportunity Line Items Sync – Salesforce to GHL Custom Objects

### How it works
This workflow migrates Salesforce Opportunity Line Item records into GoHighLevel as `custom_objects.opportunity_products` custom object records. A manual trigger reads a batch of opportunity records from Google Sheets, queries Salesforce for all line items linked to each opportunity, and loops through each line item. For each one, the workflow creates an `opportunity_products` record in GHL populated with the product name, Salesforce ID, quantity, unit price, stock availability, and related fields. It then creates a GHL association linking the new opportunity product record back to the parent opportunity. All outcomes — success, GHL create error, and association error — are logged to the Google Sheet with Wait nodes pacing API calls to avoid rate limits.

### Setup steps
1. Replace `YOUR_GHL_API_TOKEN` in the Authorization header of both active GHL HTTP nodes.
2. Replace `YOUR_GHL_LOCATION_ID` and `YOUR_GHL_ASSOCIATION_ID` in the GHL HTTP nodes.
3. Connect **Salesforce OAuth2** and replace `YOUR_SF_INSTANCE.my.salesforce.com` with your Salesforce org domain.
4. Connect **Google Sheets OAuth2** to all Sheets nodes. Replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` and confirm the tab is named `Opportunity Line Items` with an `Opportunity ID` column.
5. Adjust `Limit` to control batch size per run.
6. Run the manual trigger.

nodes.name: Section – Sheet Read & Salesforce Line Item Fetch

parameters.content:
## 📋 Sheet Read & Salesforce Line Item Fetch
Reads opportunity records from Google Sheets, limits to a batch, then queries Salesforce for all OpportunityLineItem records linked to each opportunity ID. Results are split into individual items — one per line item — before filtering.

nodes.name: Section – Line Item Existence Check & Loop

parameters.content:
## 🔍 Line Item Existence Check & Loop
Checks whether each split line item has a valid Salesforce ID. Items without an ID are skipped; valid ones enter the loop. A progress status is written to the sheet at the start of each iteration before the GHL sync begins.

nodes.name: Section – GHL Custom Object Creation & Association

parameters.content:
## 🏗️ GHL Custom Object Creation & Association
Creates an `opportunity_products` custom object record in GHL with all line item fields mapped. Then creates a GHL association linking it to the parent opportunity. All outcomes (success, GHL error, association error) are logged to the sheet with Wait nodes between calls.

## 🔑 Credentials & IDs
- **GHL Private Integration Token** → `YOUR_GHL_API_TOKEN`
- Replace `YOUR_GHL_LOCATION_ID` + `YOUR_GHL_ASSOCIATION_ID`
- **Salesforce OAuth2** → `YOUR_SF_INSTANCE.my.salesforce.com`
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** → `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`

Never hardcode real tokens, SF IDs, or instance URLs.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =SELECT FIELDS(ALL)  FROM OpportunityLineItem  WHERE OpportunityId = '{{ $json["Salesforce Opportunity ID"] }}' LIMIT 200

    "stock_available": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.StockAvailable__c ?? '' }}",
    "opportunity_id": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.OpportunityId }}",
    "quantity": {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.Quantity ?? 0 }},
    "pricebookentryid": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.PricebookEntryId }}",
    "status_code": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.Status__c?.match(/alt="([^"]+)"/)?.[1] ?? '' }}",
    "product_salesforce_id": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.Product2Id }}",
    "sap_code": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.SAP_Code__c ?? '' }}",
    "wholesale": {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.UnitPrice ?? 0 }},
    "rrp": {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.RRPAmount__c ?? 0 }},
    "discount": {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.Discount ?? 0 }},
    "sub_total": {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.TotalPrice ?? 0 }},
    "brand": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.Brand__c ?? '' }}",
    "tax_rule": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.TaxRule__c ?? '' }}",
    "vat": "{{ $json.VATAmount__c ?? '' }}",
    "vat_amount": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.VAT__c ?? '' }}",
    "total_price": {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.TotalPayableAmount__c ?? 0 }},
    "product_name": "{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.Product_Name__c ?? '' }}"
  }
}
